{{Top|canon=Wonga winga cingee wooze}}
'''Wonga, winga, cingee wooze... which of these do I choose''' was a type of choosing game, used to "randomly" determine a choice from among several options.<ref name="Hutt Gambit">''[[The Hutt Gambit]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|If you want to know how rich the Star Wars universe is, I figured the GFFA had to have an established eeny meeny equivalent, so I checked Wookieepedia and discovered that was indeed the case. Amazing.|[[Jason Fry]], on writing the [[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Expanded Edition|novelization]] of [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''The Last Jedi'']]|<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|jasoncfry|status/1067447750239928320|Jason C Fry|quote=If you want to know how rich the Star Wars universe is, I figured the GFFA had to have an established eeny meeny equivalent, so I checked Wookieepedia and discovered that was indeed the case. Amazing.|archivedate=20230721111114}}</ref>}}
The phrase is clearly meant to be the equivalent of Eenie, meenie, minie moe.
